posts.headline: DOW SURGES 200+ ON SCOTUS TARIFF RULING VICTORY
posts.body: The Dow Jones Industrial Average surged over 200 points Monday morning after the Supreme Court struck down President Trump's tariff authority in a major legal defeat for the administration's trade policy. The ruling removes significant uncertainty around trade relations, boosting market sentiment. $DIA $SPY $QQQ

posts.headline: SPOT SOARS 15% ON BLOWOUT EARNINGSBEAT
posts.body: Spotify (SPOT) jumped 15% in early trading after exceeding Q4 expectations with an EPS beat of $0.28 and revenue beating by $210M. The audio streaming giant showed strong Premium subscriber growth, indicating robust demand for ad-free tier. Momentum carries into next session. $SPOT

posts.headline: TTWO STRONG BUY - 39% UPSIDE TARGET
posts.body: Raymond James upgraded Take-Two Interactive (TTWO) to STRONG BUY with a $285 price target, representing ~39% upside from current levels. Analyst notes: 'Recent AI fears have created a buying opportunity. The sell-off is overdone.' Accumulate on any weakness. $TTWO

posts.headline: WHALES LOADING UP ON NVDA PUTS AHEAD OF EARNINGS
posts.body: Unusual options flow shows significant put buying on NVIDIA (NVDA) ahead of Wednesday's Q4 earnings report. Bears are positioning for disappointment following the AI-driven rally. Expect increased volatility around the print. $NVDA

posts.headline: 10-YEAR YIELDS DROP TO 4.15% - LOWEST IN A MONTH
posts.body: Bond yields are falling as tariff uncertainty clears. The 10-year Treasury yield has dipped to 4.15%, its lowest level in about a month, providing support for equity valuations. Fed still pricing 3 cuts for 2026 according to FedWatch. $TLT $IEF

posts.headline: KEY EARNINGS THIS WEEK: NVDA, ADBE, SNOW
posts.body: Major earnings on deck: NVIDIA (Wed after close), Adobe (Thurs before open), Snowflake (Fri after close). Results will set tone for AI infrastructure and cloud spending. Be prepared for high volatility around these names. $NVDA $ADBE $SNOW
